item.title: DODIK: SUPPLEMENTS TO BiH LAW ON EXCISE DUTIES WILL NOT BE ADOPTED
item.description: BANJA LUKA, MARCH 24 /SRNA/ - The bill supplementing the Law on Excise Duties in BiH will not be adopted at the BiH level, as the original revenues from excise duties belong to Republika Srpska, SNSD leader Milorad Dodik said today. item.title: REPUBLIKA SRPSKA NATIONAL TEAM WINS NINE EUROPEAN MEDALS IN CRETE
item.description: BANJA LUKA, MARCH 24 /SRNA/ – The national jiu-jitsu team of Republika Srpska achieved a historic success at the European Championship in Crete, winning nine medals in competition with 1,700 athletes from 31 countries, the Banja Luka-based Jiu-Jitsu Club Borac announced. Filip Šantić won a gold medal at the recently held European Championship, while Milica Panić claimed silver.
